about: Dot matrix: a wordless story told by dots on a dark halftone grid. The visitor and Breakout are blooms of dots that hop on the beat, trade ripples and merge; captions are small and verbatim. Example: the full Breakout suite, from an anonymous visit to a booked meeting, with a Snake easter egg in the long wait. Times in bars at 96 BPM (1 bar = 2.5 s).

captions.text: Give every visitor a helpful first conversation.
Stay useful until buyers are ready.
Know when a key account comes back.
